description: Design, improve, and evaluate clear, reliable AI prompts.

defaultPrompt: Help me design a prompt for this task and ask only for essential missing context.
Improve this prompt while preserving my intent; explain the important changes.
Create a small test set and rubric to evaluate these prompt versions.
interface.longDescription: Turn goals and constraints into clear, model-aware prompts; improve existing prompts while preserving intent; and design practical evaluation cases to compare quality, reliability, and safety. Distinguish prompt-only behavior from capabilities that require tools or application code. Treat prompt results as empirical, model-dependent—not guaranteed.

name: prompt-engineer
